records.title: DA-VAE: Plug-in Latent Compression for Diffusion via Detail Alignment
records.reason: DA-VAE expands a pretrained diffusion VAE latent while preserving detail structure, enabling high-resolution image generation with fewer tokens; experiments report up to 6x speedup for SD3.5 generation. It is diffusion image generation, not LLM inference; the PyTorch compile lineage is incidental.

records.title: Agentic Harness for Real-World Compilers
records.reason: llvm-harness supplies a compiler-bug benchmark/tools for LLM agents and reports improved bug-fixing success. It measures agent software-engineering capability rather than model inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: EditHF-1M: A Million-Scale Rich Human Preference Feedback for Image Editing
records.reason: EditHF-1M provides human preference data and an MLLM evaluator/reward model for image editing. Evaluation focuses on preference alignment and edited-image quality, not inference efficiency; its use of an MLLM is incidental.
